stories.title: La nuit où l’UDC a désigné le parlement comme «le danger»

en.title: The night when the UDC designated parliament as 'the danger'
en.summary: Switzerland's largest party held an evening event on federal plaza where party members delivered speeches in multiple languages describing parliament as dangerous and criticizing elected officials, escalating political rhetoric.

stories.title: SCO – SUI: Vergangene Duelle – Shaqiris Prachtstor in Köln und die Festung Hampden Park

en.title: SCO – SUI: Past matchups – Shaqiri's brilliant goal in Cologne and the fortress Hampden Park
en.summary: Switzerland faces Scotland in a competitive match for only the second time this century, with the nations having drawn 1:1 in 2024.

stories.title: En direct – Primes maladie: la tension monte avant l'annonce de la hausse annuelle

en.title: Live – Health insurance premiums: tension rises before announcement of annual increase
en.summary: Switzerland's federal health minister will announce 2027 health insurance premiums at 2 p.m., with costs continuing to burden household budgets significantly.

stories.title: La fabrique des légendes ou l’art de transformer l’histoire en montres

en.title: The making of legends or the art of turning history into watches
en.summary: Watchmakers transform historical narratives into timepieces designed to evoke emotions, blending factual events with storytelling through their product designs.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - EU-Debatte: Ständerat will eine Zuwanderungsabgabe – Zuzüger sollen künftig einen Strafregisterauszug vorlegen müssen

en.title: LIVE TICKER - EU Debate: Upper House wants immigration fee – newcomers to present criminal record extracts in future
en.summary: Switzerland's upper chamber is debating new EU treaties over three days. The chamber is considering an immigration fee and requiring newcomers to provide criminal record documentation.

stories.title: L'action Shein plonge de plus de 10% après des résultats maussades

en.title: Shein stock plunges more than 10% after disappointing results
en.summary: Ultra-fast fashion company Shein's stock fell sharply on Hong Kong's exchange following weak financial results affected by stricter regulatory requirements, particularly in Europe.

stories.title: Gentherapien – Wieso verändern Forschende menschliche Embryonen?

en.title: Gene therapies – Why are researchers modifying human embryos?
en.summary: Research on human embryos raises ethical questions. New studies on this topic were published this year.

stories.title: Ferdinand Hodler, de l’intime à l’infini, du physique au mystique

en.title: Ferdinand Hodler, from the intimate to the infinite, from the physical to the mystical
en.summary: The Museum of the Reformation in Geneva explores painter Ferdinand Hodler's spirituality through an exhibition examining his religious perspective and artistic philosophy.

stories.title: Affaire Signa: la Finma clôt sa procédure contre Julius Baer en exigeant 250 millions de fonds propres supplémentaires et en confisquant 10 millions de francs

en.title: Signa affair: Finma closes procedure against Julius Baer, requiring 250 million in additional capital and confiscating 10 million francs
en.summary: Swiss financial regulator Finma concluded an enforcement action against Julius Baer regarding the Signa credit collapse and money laundering violations, imposing capital requirements and asset confiscation. Three former employees face separate proceedings for compliance and surveillance rule breaches.

stories.title: Signa-Pleite – Finma stellt Verstösse bei Julius Bär fest

en.title: Signa bankruptcy – Finma identifies violations at Julius Baer
en.summary: Swiss financial regulator Finma concluded an investigation into Julius Baer related to the Signa insolvency and found compliance violations.

stories.title: Plus de 8 millions de réfugiés et déplacés menacés par le recul de l'aide internationale, alerte le HCR

en.title: Over 8 million refugees and displaced persons threatened by declining international aid, UNHCR warns
en.summary: The United Nations refugee agency warned that approximately 8.3 million people risk losing aid this year due to budget cuts affecting refugee support organizations across critical zones.

stories.title: Près de 8,3 millions de réfugiés et déplacés menacés par le recul de l'aide internationale, alerte le HCR

en.title: Nearly 8.3 million refugees and displaced persons threatened by decline in international aid, warns UNHCR
en.summary: The UN refugee agency reports that funding cuts have reduced available resources from 5.2 billion to 3.9 billion dollars between 2024 and 2025, putting support organizations at a breaking point and endangering 8.3 million people from receiving assistance this year.

stories.title: Lindt & Sprüngli verkauft deutlich weniger Schokolade als erwartet – die Aktie bricht ein

en.title: Lindt & Sprüngli sells significantly less chocolate than expected – stock plummets
en.summary: Lindt & Sprüngli reduced its revenue forecast for the second time this year, citing a hot summer's negative impact on sales, though underlying challenges run deeper.

stories.title: MELDUNGEN WIRTSCHAFT - Der Schweizer Zugbauer Stadler Rail erhält einen neuen CEO +++ Finma rügt Julius Bär

en.title: BUSINESS REPORTS - Swiss train manufacturer Stadler Rail appoints new CEO +++ Finma reprimands Julius Baer
en.summary: Swiss train builder Stadler Rail has appointed a new chief executive officer. Separately, Finma has issued a reprimand to Julius Baer.

stories.title: So viel Luftverteidigung braucht die Schweiz – und so viel kostet es

en.title: How much air defense Switzerland needs – and what it costs
en.summary: The Swiss government must decide whether to acquire a second air defense system with greater range. Effective defense against ballistic missiles and hypersonic weapons requires coordination with military partners.

stories.title: Staus an den Tankstellen: Italiens Energiekonzerne deckeln die Spritpreise

en.title: Queues at petrol stations: Italy's energy companies cap fuel prices
en.summary: Italian energy companies have imposed price caps on fuel, prompting government approval while companies seek to avoid taxes on windfall profits. The measure has not satisfied all parties involved.

stories.title: DATENANALYSE - 25 Jahre nach dem Grounding: Die Swiss fliegt in deutlich weniger Länder als die Swissair

en.title: Data analysis - 25 years after the grounding: Swiss flies to significantly fewer countries than Swissair
en.summary: A comparison of flight schedules shows that Zurich had more destinations accessible via Swissair in 2001 than via Swiss in 2026, particularly with long-haul routes to Africa being drastically reduced.
